newsitem.title: CHINA: China slams Japan MP over trip to disputed island.
newsitem.headline: China slams Japan MP over trip to disputed island.

text.p: China on Tuesday slammed a Japanese legislator for visiting one of a group of disputed islands in the East China Sea claimed by Japan, China and Taiwan.
"The Chinese side expresses its strong indignation and opposition," Foreign Ministry spokesman Shen Guofang told a news briefing.
"The illegal landing...is a serious violation of China's territorial sovereignty," Shen said.
"The Diaoyu islands have been a part of Chinese territory since ancient times," he said.

Shingo Nishimura, a conservative member of the main opposition New Frontier Party (Shinshinto), on Monday inspected the security situation and held a brief commemorative ceremony on the Senkaku Islands, known in Chinese as the Diaoyus, Nishimura's office said in a statement.

Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto, however, was quick to distance the central government from Nishimura's group, which included former cabinet minister Shintaro Ishihara, author of the 1980s nationalist treatise "A Japan That Can Say No".
